errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such repository; or this appview keeps no index, so it knows no pulls or issues.

labels.description: The labels the repository defines, in its order, for a filter to name. Absent when it defines none.

authors.description: Who opened pulls or issues of its kind, in any state, the most recent first, for a filter to name. Absent when there are none.

openCount.description: How many of its kind are open, of those `q` matches.

closedCount.description: How many of its kind are closed or merged, of those `q` matches.

q.description: A filter, in words: `label:<name>` (each must be on it), `-label:<name>`, `no:label`, `author:<handle or did>` (any of them), `state:open|closed|merged` (over `state`), `is:pull|issue`, and words its title or body holds, ignoring case. Double quotes keep a value or words together; a qualifier it does not know is a word. The counts are of those it matches.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle; a name the repository had before, or an owner it moved from with its agreement, finds it under the name it has now.

state.description: Open ones, or those closed and merged; open if absent.

cursor.description: How many the pages before held.

main.description: A repository's pulls or its issues, open or closed, newest first, a page at a time: follow `cursor` until it is absent. `q` filters them as GitHub's search does. No authentication needed; asked as an account, with a service token or the pages' session cookie, a private repository it is a member of is read too, and the answer is that account's alone.
